architecture: Full articulated kernel regression conditioned on explicit gravity direction; fixed selected V3 kernel settings
baseline: linear root and local quaternion SLERP through complete ancestor hierarchy
selection: Validation position + 0.1 * rotation; retained V3 selected learner is the control and initial incumbent
notes: No new raw data or untouched confirmation corpus.
Direction is transformed from explicit world context into the known start-anchor frame.
Kernel width is adjusted by sqrt(637/641) to retain the original raw-feature distance denominator.
All previous quality gates retained and V3 selected control added as a stronger baseline.
Physical-context API can represent acceleration and an explicit static support plane; current training uses direction only.
training_objective: Cohort-weighted regularized regression of complete curve coefficients fitted from training labels; temporal errors are acceptance metrics, not direct regression loss terms.
source_environment_limit: Y-up is a declared conversion convention assumption checked against static rest orientation, not a measured gravity magnitude, floor or contact label.
